source.title: Diabetes Prevalence and Incidence Among Medicare Beneficiaries — United States, 2001–2015

population.enrollment_notes: Source: women among Medicare FFS ≥68 with 60-month A+B window. MVP approximates Option B + sex filter; sex code '2' = female per CMS beneficiary sex identity.

numerator.notes: Approximated by mbsf_sp_diabetes_v1 at compile time.

analysis.notes: Holdout demographic stratum — do not use for calibration fitting.

result.notes: Table women 2015 prevalence 29.6%; MoE <0.02% in source text.

assumptions: Demographic holdout independent of overall/train prevalence targets.
Sex code '2' maps to source women stratum.

governance.rationale: Frozen holdout for Phase 3/6. Must not be used to tune calibration. Distinct from Phase 2 diagnostic overall LIT-03 finding.
